text:
sam_support: customer reported 403s right after our scheduled key rotation. they think their API key was rotated on their side but they forwarded a curl showing the same key. ticket #45219.

mike_billing: can you paste the response body? 403 could be entitlement or plan gating.

sam_support: here's the curl and response (redacted):
```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_prod_XXXX' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"error":"request_blocked","reason":"plan_limit"}
```

anya_eng: interesting — we return 403 for a few things (invalid key, rate limit, and plan_gate). body says plan_limit which is a strong hint. does the ticket include customer org_id?

sam_support: org_id=org_9b7f, customer says they were on "Pro". they also mentioned a recent invoice dispute.

lee_sre: quick check: any recent plan/sku changes for org_9b7f? I can run entitlement audit.

deploybot: entitlement-audit job started for org_9b7f (job id eb2c3).

mike_billing: pulling billing history... looks like they hit a monthly SKU threshold yesterday and auto-grace was toggled off because of the dispute. that would make requests be blocked by the entitlement check.

jess_csm: customer support message: "We didn't change keys — service stopped working overnight." they're blocked from UI too.

anya_eng: root cause sounds like plan gating. support should confirm that the response body includes reason=plan_limit. We need to avoid customers assuming key rotation. Can we add a more descriptive error message or header?

sam_support: customer-facing clarity would help. right now 403 with generic "invalid key" UI treat it like creds issue.

lee_sre: short-term mitigation: mike can temporarily re-enable auto-grace or lift the gate for org_9b7f so they can resume. long-term: change API to include X-Entitlement-Reason header with values like "plan_limit" or "entitlement:block:sku".

mike_billing: I can re-enable grace for this org for 48 hours. doing it now.

deploybot: entitlement-audit job eb2c3 completed: status=blocked, block_reason=sku_threshold_exceeded, last_invoice=2026-02-28, grace_window=false.

mike_billing: grace re-enabled for org_9b7f until 2026-03-05. asked finance to follow up on dispute.

sam_support: relayed to customer, they confirmed service restored. they were surprised but appreciative.

anya_eng: ticket action items: 1) Add an X-Entitlement-Reason header on 403 responses (short-term) 2) Update docs/console messaging to show plan_limit vs auth failure and give repro steps for customers 3) Add a monitoring alert for sudden spikes in plan_gate 403s so we can catch mass misattribution.

lee_sre: I'll file a follow-up in eng-oncall to scope header change and ingestion of entitlement codes in observability (tracing + console).

jess_csm: customer success to schedule a proactive check-in and confirm billing follow-up.

sam_support: closing thread for now — ticket updated and marked resolved after grace re-enable. will reopen if customer sees more 403s. :white_check_mark:
